import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a bar plot for survival count by class and sex
sns.countplot(data=df, x='class', hue='sex', palette='pastel', ax=ax)

# Add labels and title
ax.set_title('Survival Count by Class and Sex on the Titanic', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Count of Passengers', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
ax.legend(title='Sex')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
